title: triage — triage's verdict (task 10)
description: The triage agent's output (docs/stage-io, task 10). Encodes triage_gate's shape checks: readiness enum, conventional title, labels nameset, questions policy per readiness, and decisions with non-empty question/decision. `basis` is required on each decision for non-architecture issues; that is a gate check (it depends on issue.json) and is not expressible here, so it stays in the gate. _io is stamped by the server.

questions.description: The gate requires questions to be non-empty for needs_info and empty for ready/not_actionable.
